name: Bored Bunny
rootCause: NFT project Bored Bunny is suspected of being a Rug Pull project. Some netizens said that 2,000 ETH raised have been transferred out, and some of them have been transferred to Binan. In addition, this address had similar behavior 1-2 months ago, associated with 2 NFT items that almost went to zero. Currently Bored Bunny's Discord has turned off all people all channels to speak.
